name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> game-function name. 'walk_path_animation_loop' accurately reflects the body: iterate a pre-computed direction-byte path and play each 6-frame walk-step animation. No Ghidra address residue in the name. Domain = field/battle walk animation.
purpose: Animate a character walking along a pre-computed direction-byte path, playing one 6-frame slide-step animation per path byte.
logic_summary: for step_iter in [0, step_count): read dir = path_buf[step_iter]; dispatch 0->fd2_walk_step_down, 1->fd2_walk_step_left, 2->fd2_walk_step_up, else(3)->fd2_walk_step_right, each passing char_idx. Loop bound uses signed comparison. char_idx is forwarded unchanged to every walk_step_* callee (cached in ESI, pushed as a stack arg). Compiler-injected __CHK(0x18) stack probe in prologue is not source.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_walk_path_animation_loop(uint32 char_idx, uint32 path_buf, uint32 step_count)

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-character index. Forwarded unchanged to each fd2_walk_step_* callee, which index data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr by it. Both callers pass char_idx (AI: char_idx; player: param_1=selected char).
params.reason: Accurately names the value; matches the four walk_step_* callees' char_idx parameter and the runtime-char index semantics. No address residue.

params.name: path_buf
params.semantics: Pointer (32-bit flat) to a direction-byte array produced by fd2_pathfind_to_destination. Each byte: 0=down/S, 1=left/W, 2=up/N, 3=right/E. Caller AI passes the malloc(0x20) path buffer; player passes malloc(range_remaining) buffer. Read as *(byte*)(path_buf + step_iter).
params.reason: Name correctly describes the buffer of path direction bytes. Both callers fill it via fd2_pathfind_to_destination then pass it here. No address residue.

params.name: step_count
params.semantics: Number of path bytes to process = step count returned by fd2_pathfind_to_destination. Used as a signed loop bound ((int)step_iter < (int)step_count). Callers only invoke this when the returned count is non-zero (and != 0xFF in the player path).
params.reason: Name matches the value: count of steps / path bytes to animate. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: each walk_step_* callee advances the character's tile position, updates facing, scrolls the viewport, and runs fd2_check_tile_event_post_action after the slide.
